rock_hall.name: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame
rock_hall.price_text: ≈ $35 adult · discounts for kids and seniors (check current rates)
rock_hall.hours: Daily, roughly 10:00–17:00, later on some days · check on the day
rock_hall.tip: Buy tickets online and go early; the top floors and the Hall of Fame gallery get busy by midday.

cleveland_museum_art.name: Cleveland Museum of Art
cleveland_museum_art.price_text: Free general admission · special exhibitions may charge
cleveland_museum_art.hours: Closed Monday · Tue–Sun roughly 10:00–17:00 · check on the day
cleveland_museum_art.tip: Free entry makes this the best rainy-day stop in the city; the armour court and Asian galleries are highlights.

west_side_market.name: West Side Market
west_side_market.price_text: Free to enter · pay per stall
west_side_market.hours: Mon, Wed, Fri, Sat roughly 07:00–16:00 · Sun 10:00–14:00 · closed Tue and Thu · check on the day
west_side_market.tip: Come hungry and bring cash for small stalls; the old market hall is worth a slow walk even if you buy nothing.

severance_hall.name: Severance Hall
severance_hall.price_text: Concert tickets vary by program · check the orchestra's site
severance_hall.hours: Show times vary · box office hours check on the day
severance_hall.tip: The Cleveland Orchestra plays here; book ahead for weekend concerts and arrive early to see the art deco lobby.

case_western.name: Case Western Reserve University
case_western.hours: Campus open daily · buildings have their own hours
case_western.tip: Walk through the quad and past the historic buildings on your way between the museums; it is a pleasant 20-minute stroll.

memphis_kiddie_park.name: Memphis Kiddie Park
memphis_kiddie_park.price_text: Rides sold per ticket or as a wristband · check current prices
memphis_kiddie_park.hours: Seasonal, roughly May–September · check on the day
memphis_kiddie_park.tip: A small vintage amusement park for young kids; check that it is open before you drive out, as hours are seasonal.

edgewater_park.name: Edgewater Park
edgewater_park.tip: Best free skyline view in Cleveland: look back east over the lake at sunset.

tremont_walk.name: Tremont neighbourhood walk
tremont_walk.hours: Always open · shops and cafes have their own hours
tremont_walk.tip: Wander the side streets for churches, galleries and coffee; it is hilly, so wear comfortable shoes.

flats_east_bank.name: Flats East Bank riverfront
flats_east_bank.price_text: Free to walk · pay for food and drinks
flats_east_bank.hours: Boardwalk always open · bars and restaurants later
flats_east_bank.tip: Walk the river boardwalk at dusk, then pick a patio for dinner; it is a short walk from downtown.

great_lakes_science.name: Great Lakes Science Center
great_lakes_science.hours: Roughly daily 10:00–17:00 · check on the day
great_lakes_science.tip: Good for families with kids and right next to the Rock Hall, so pair the two in one trip.

lola_bistro.name: Lola Bistro (East 4th Street)
lola_bistro.hours: Dinner daily · weekend brunch · check on the day
lola_bistro.tip: East 4th Street is packed with restaurants; book ahead for weekend dinner.

ohio_city_brewery.name: Ohio City brewery stop
ohio_city_brewery.hours: Afternoons and evenings · check each taproom
ohio_city_brewery.tip: Combine with West Side Market: market in the morning, a taproom patio in the afternoon.

lake_view_cemetery.name: Lake View Cemetery
lake_view_cemetery.hours: Daily, roughly 07:30–17:30 · check on the day
lake_view_cemetery.tip: Quiet green space with the James A. Garfield Memorial; drive or take a rideshare, it is a long walk from University Circle.

little_italy.name: Little Italy walk
little_italy.price_text: Free to walk · pay for food
little_italy.hours: Always open · restaurants have their own hours
little_italy.tip: Walk Mayfield Road for bakeries and old-school Italian restaurants; it is a short walk from the museums.

cleveland_metroparks_zoo.name: Cleveland Metroparks Zoo
cleveland_metroparks_zoo.price_text: Admission varies by season · check current prices
cleveland_metroparks_zoo.hours: Daily, roughly 10:00–17:00 · check on the day
cleveland_metroparks_zoo.tip: Big enough for half a day with kids; go in the morning before it gets hot.

playhouse_square.name: Playhouse Square
playhouse_square.price_text: Tickets vary by show · check the venue
playhouse_square.hours: Show times vary · box office hours check on the day
playhouse_square.tip: See a touring show in one of the restored theatres, and look up at the chandelier outside after dark.

soldiers_sailors.name: Soldiers' and Sailors' Monument
soldiers_sailors.hours: Daily, roughly 09:00–16:00 · check on the day
soldiers_sailors.tip: Quick free stop on Public Square; the outdoor observation deck gives a good look over downtown.

towpath_trail.name: Ohio & Erie Canal Towpath Trail
towpath_trail.tip: Flat paved path along the old canal; rent a bike or walk a short stretch from Ohio City.

market_garden.name: Market Garden Brewery
market_garden.hours: Daily, roughly 11:00–late · check on the day
market_garden.tip: Right across from West Side Market; a big patio makes it an easy lunch stop after the market.

achristmasstoryhouse.name: A Christmas Story House
achristmasstoryhouse.hours: Daily, roughly 10:00–17:00 · check on the day
achristmasstoryhouse.tip: Fun for fans of the film; the house is in a residential street in Tremont, so combine it with a neighbourhood walk.

cleveland_museum_natural_histo.name: Cleveland Museum of Natural History
cleveland_museum_natural_histo.hours: Daily, roughly 10:00–17:00 · check on the day
cleveland_museum_natural_histo.tip: Strong for families and dinosaurs; it sits next to the art museum, so plan both in one day.
